notes.title: Update details for Version 0.0.4
notes.content: [p]We sincerely apologise for the prolonged silence since the release.[/p][p]We are currently developing tutorial functionality, though it appears this will take a little more time.[/p][p]Therefore, we will be implementing minor updates within the game!![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703078/f644af029a8acb9030fd88b3dbb39f6e3b92a88b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703078/c5da5f54d39fd15ae95af1916f8d08bd040c44cd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703078/c558fbd0567a51a5cde9400b0bd2ad26dd2ed551.png"][/img]※The screenshots shown are work-in-progress images. They may change after release.[/p][p][/p][p]This update primarily involves changing the font.[/p][p]We believe this will make the previously rather plain screens look richer.[/p][p]For the next update, we are considering adding one more song.[/p][p]We haven't set a date for the next update yet, so please be patient.[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time![/p]

notes.title: Updated to version 0.0.3!!
notes.content: [h1]Update Details[/h1][h2]Light[/h2][p]Light is now more vividly expressed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703078/70ab789c27e84df4ab4e7b167f69a5dd6a0025e2.png"][/img][/p][h2]Notes[/h2][p]The judgement of upper and lower notes has been changed![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703078/3088821ba2ee487ea3a8d0200506c9fda4d4c2ea.png"][/img][/p][p]Particles are now added when touched![/p][h2]Judgement[/h2][p]The judgement evaluation time has been changed![/p][p](Perfect: 0.07 seconds → 0.05, Optimal: 0.115 → 0.1, Solid: 0.12 → 0.12) [/p]
